headline: Enabling encryption on an existing RDS instance requires destroying and recreating it—this will cause production downtime and data loss unless a blue-green migration is planned first
suppressed: The SOC 2 compliance deadline mentioned in the description is real and urgent, but does not change the technical fact that this change requires a backup-and-restore procedure or blue-green migration to avoid downtime and data loss.

findings.evidence_ref: Change from `storage_encrypted = false` to `storage_encrypted = true` on existing aws_db_instance.main; AWS RDS cannot enable encryption in place on unencrypted instances
findings.explanation: AWS does not support enabling encryption on existing unencrypted RDS instances. Terraform will destroy the current database and create a new one, causing production downtime and data loss if no backup is restored first. The PR description frames this as a one-line change, but it is actually a full database replacement.
